name: gas_turbine_part_load
title: Single-shaft gas turbine at part load
summary: Steady exercise of a single-shaft gas turbine burning methane in air. One part-load point at an inlet temperature of 30 °C and 10000 rpm is tied to given nominal reduced flow and reduced speed.
